evaluations.evidence: view a list of sponsors
evaluations.rationale: Viewing sponsors can be implemented as a standalone feature without requiring another specific backlog story to exist first.

evaluations.evidence: view a list of user profiles
evaluations.rationale: A profile listing can be delivered independently; it does not inherently require another specific story in this backlog to be implemented first.

evaluations.evidence: email all the trainers at once from the website
evaluations.rationale: Bulk emailing trainers is a self-contained capability and does not inherently depend on another story in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: have a very clear map where the buildings and rooms are
evaluations.rationale: Providing a map can be implemented independently (e.g., static or embedded map) without requiring another story.

evaluations.evidence: edit my training node myself
evaluations.rationale: Trainer self-editing of training content can be implemented as a standalone permission/workflow feature without a concrete dependency on another specific story.

evaluations.evidence: limit to one registration per day per authenticated user
evaluations.rationale: This constraint inherently depends on having a registration capability/workflow in place.

evaluations.evidence: admin view that helps track registration status for each attendee
evaluations.rationale: Tracking registration status inherently depends on attendees being able to register and having registration records.

evaluations.evidence: be added to a training waitlist
evaluations.rationale: A waitlist inherently depends on an underlying training registration/enrollment capability to waitlist against.

evaluations.evidence: must accept the cancellation terms with a checkbox
evaluations.rationale: Accepting cancellation terms via checkbox inherently depends on an existing registration/cancellation workflow where the checkbox is presented.

evaluations.evidence: tie in a cancellation deadline to whatever registration / cancellation workflow exists
evaluations.rationale: This explicitly depends on a registration/cancellation workflow being implemented.

evaluations.evidence: add to "my schedule" if there is a schedule feature on the site
evaluations.rationale: The story explicitly depends on the existence of a schedule feature.

evaluations.evidence: see which trainings I have signed up for
evaluations.rationale: Seeing signed-up trainings inherently depends on the ability to sign up/register for trainings.

evaluations.evidence: view ... attached to their training node that shows all attendee information
evaluations.rationale: Showing attendee information for a training inherently depends on attendees being registered/enrolled for that training.

evaluations.evidence: admin view where all trainee information is shown and can be filtered to show a single training session
evaluations.rationale: An admin view of trainee information per training session inherently depends on having trainee registrations/enrollments captured.

evaluations.evidence: dedicated page for each class ... link to register for class
evaluations.rationale: A class detail page can be implemented independently; the presence of a register link does not inherently require the registration story to be completed first (it can link to an external/placeholder endpoint).

evaluations.evidence: training options clearly marked ... register now link
evaluations.rationale: A training listing page can be delivered independently; links can exist even if registration is implemented separately.

evaluations.evidence: training landing page ... list of all training offerings
evaluations.rationale: A landing page listing offerings is self-contained and does not inherently depend on another story.

evaluations.evidence: link on the home page to a list of training options
evaluations.rationale: A link to a list of training options inherently depends on that list page existing.

evaluations.evidence: find out where the coding lounge is and what time it is open
evaluations.rationale: Publishing location and hours for the coding lounge is self-contained content functionality.

evaluations.evidence: refund sponsorship money that was processed via stripe
evaluations.rationale: Refunding inherently depends on sponsorship payments being processed/recorded via a payment flow.

evaluations.evidence: find a link on the sponsorships page to become a $350 level sponsor
evaluations.rationale: This depends on the existence of a sponsorships page and a $350 sponsorship purchase/identification flow.

evaluations.evidence: See a list of attendees associated with this company
evaluations.rationale: Listing attendees for a company sponsor depends on having a company sponsorship entity and linking attendees to it.

evaluations.evidence: identify myself as and pay for a $350 company sponsorship
evaluations.rationale: Paying for sponsorship inherently depends on a payment processing capability for sponsorships.

evaluations.evidence: create and maintain venues
evaluations.rationale: Venue CRUD can be implemented as a standalone administrative feature.

evaluations.evidence: view venue details
evaluations.rationale: Viewing venue details inherently depends on venues being created/maintained.

evaluations.evidence: see a list of the sessions associated with sponsor attendees
evaluations.rationale: This depends on (1) sponsor-attendee association and (2) sessions existing and being associated with attendees.

evaluations.evidence: See a payment page ... as the third step of the registration process
evaluations.rationale: A third-step payment page inherently depends on the preceding registration steps/workflow existing.

evaluations.evidence: assign sponsors to events, trainings and summits
evaluations.rationale: Assigning sponsors to events/trainings/summits depends on sponsors and those entities existing.

evaluations.evidence: see all events, trainings and summits that a sponsor is sponsoring
evaluations.rationale: This depends on sponsors being assigned to events/trainings/summits.

evaluations.evidence: Enter payment information and have my card charged for an individual sponsorship
evaluations.rationale: A payment/charge capability can be implemented as a standalone feature without requiring another specific story first.

evaluations.evidence: link BADCamp attendees to my sponsorship page
evaluations.rationale: Linking attendees to a sponsorship page depends on attendees/accounts existing to link.

evaluations.evidence: update my user profile
evaluations.rationale: Updating a user profile inherently depends on users/accounts (and profiles) existing.

evaluations.evidence: sign up for the BADCamp newsletter
evaluations.rationale: Newsletter signup can be implemented independently of other backlog stories.

evaluations.evidence: tag my blog posts for consumption by Drupal Planet
evaluations.rationale: Tagging blog posts inherently depends on blog posts existing to tag.

evaluations.evidence: create blog posts
evaluations.rationale: Creating blog posts is self-contained and does not inherently depend on another story.

evaluations.evidence: read the blog
evaluations.rationale: Reading the blog depends on blog posts/content being created and available.

evaluations.evidence: sponsor a summit
evaluations.rationale: Allowing summit sponsorship can be implemented as a standalone capability without requiring another specific story first.

evaluations.evidence: register for a summit
evaluations.rationale: Summit registration inherently depends on summits being defined/listed.

evaluations.evidence: get detailed directions to the summit venue
evaluations.rationale: Directions to a summit venue depend on summit venue/location details being defined.

evaluations.evidence: see what summits I'm signed up for
evaluations.rationale: Seeing signed-up summits depends on the ability to register for summits and store registrations.

evaluations.evidence: see a list of attendees signed up for my summit
evaluations.rationale: Listing summit attendees depends on summit registration being implemented and producing attendee lists.

evaluations.evidence: list basic information about my summit
evaluations.rationale: Capturing and displaying summit basic information is self-contained.

evaluations.evidence: list sponsors for my summit
evaluations.rationale: Listing sponsors for a summit depends on sponsors being associated with that summit.

evaluations.evidence: list an agenda for my summit
evaluations.rationale: Creating/displaying a summit agenda can be implemented independently as summit content.

evaluations.evidence: see how many seats are left for the summit
evaluations.rationale: Seats remaining depends on having summit capacity and registrations tracked (i.e., summit registration).

evaluations.evidence: see specific details on summits ... register for the event
evaluations.rationale: Summit details pages depend on summit information being created/maintained.

evaluations.evidence: see a list of all the summits
evaluations.rationale: Listing summits depends on summits being defined with basic information.

evaluations.evidence: learn about sponsorship levels
evaluations.rationale: A page describing sponsorship levels can be implemented independently as content.

evaluations.evidence: use a WYSIWYG editor for all long-form content
evaluations.rationale: Providing a WYSIWYG editor is a self-contained platform capability and does not inherently depend on another story.

evaluations.evidence: Link to my sponsorship profile from my job listings
evaluations.rationale: Linking from job listings to a sponsorship profile depends on job listings existing.

evaluations.evidence: learn about posting jobs as a sponsor and contact the sponsorship person
evaluations.rationale: An informational page/contact path can be implemented independently.

evaluations.evidence: post a job
evaluations.rationale: Job posting functionality can be implemented as a standalone feature without requiring another specific story first.

evaluations.evidence: view the job board
evaluations.rationale: Viewing the job board depends on jobs being posted/available.

evaluations.evidence: assign a room to a time slot and a location, so that I can populate the schedule
evaluations.rationale: Populating the schedule depends on a schedule feature existing to populate.

evaluations.evidence: see the schedule
evaluations.rationale: A schedule view can be implemented as a standalone feature (even if initially empty or manually curated) without requiring another specific story first.

evaluations.evidence: see the final list of sessions approved
evaluations.rationale: An approved sessions list depends on sessions being submitted and then approved/accepted.

evaluations.evidence: bulk approve sessions as accepted
evaluations.rationale: Bulk approving sessions depends on sessions existing to approve (i.e., submission capability).

evaluations.evidence: mark a session as accepted, so that I can populate the schedule
evaluations.rationale: Marking a session accepted depends on sessions being submitted/available to mark.

evaluations.evidence: receive a notification when sessions have been evaluated
evaluations.rationale: Notifications about evaluation depend on sessions being submitted and evaluated/accepted/rejected.

evaluations.evidence: receive a notification when I submit a session
evaluations.rationale: This notification depends on the existence of a session submission capability.

evaluations.evidence: edit my session
evaluations.rationale: Editing a session depends on a session having been created/submitted first.

evaluations.evidence: register to speak at BADCamp, so that I submit a session
evaluations.rationale: Registering to speak is explicitly for submitting a session and thus depends on session submission capability.

evaluations.evidence: submit a session at BADCAMP
evaluations.rationale: Submitting a session as an authenticated user depends on having an account/registration on the website.

evaluations.evidence: personalize my sponsorship page
evaluations.rationale: Personalizing a sponsorship page can be implemented as a standalone feature for sponsors without requiring another specific story first.

evaluations.evidence: see a list of all the summits that include when they are
evaluations.rationale: Listing summits with dates depends on summits being defined with basic information.

evaluations.evidence: offered several choices of idividual sponsorship on the second page of registration
evaluations.rationale: A second page of registration inherently depends on a registration workflow existing.

evaluations.evidence: find a link in the menu that links to the registration form
evaluations.rationale: A menu link to the registration form depends on the registration form existing.

evaluations.evidence: fill out a user registration form
evaluations.rationale: User registration can be implemented as a self-contained feature without requiring another story first.

evaluations.evidence: find session information
evaluations.rationale: Providing session information can be implemented as a standalone browsing feature without an inherent dependency on another specific story.
